{"step":2,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_get_chunk","line":52,"var":"data->Data / data->Size","code":"c_size = *((uint16_t *) data->Data);","note":"The first two attacker bytes determine the length of the next chunk, so later parsing decisions are fully input-driven.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"reader buffer"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":209,"var":"card","code":"sc_connect_card(reader, &card);","note":"The synthetic reader is connected to OpenSC, causing the Coolkey card driver to initialize card state from the fuzzed APDU stream.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"reader callbacks"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_init","line":2280,"var":"r","code":"r = coolkey_initialize(card);","note":"The Coolkey driver initialization runs during card connect and populates driver-private state from card data.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"card driver init"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_initialize","line":2068,"var":"object_id","code":"r = coolkey_add_object(priv, object_id, NULL, object_len, 0);","note":"Each listed Coolkey object is recorded in the driver's private object list; the list stores heap-backed object metadata that later teardown walks and frees.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"card APDU responses"}]},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_add_object","line":1969,"var":"new_object.data","code":"new_object.data = malloc(object_length + add_v1_record);","note":"When an object has inline data, the driver allocates a heap buffer and transfers ownership into the object list, creating the memory that will be released during cleanup.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"object payload"}]},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_finish","line":1949,"var":"priv","code":"if (priv) { coolkey_free_private_data(priv); }","note":"Card teardown frees the Coolkey private state once through the driver's finish hook.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"control","via":"driver lifecycle"}]},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_free_private_data","line":819,"var":"o->data","code":"free(o->data); o->data = NULL;","note":"The object list is iterated and each stored heap buffer is freed; if the same private state is finalized again, this becomes a double free on the same pointer.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"priv->objects_list"}]},
{"step":9,"file":"src/libopensc/card.c","function":"sc_disconnect_card","line":420,"var":"card->ops->finish","code":"if (card->ops->finish) { int r = card->ops->finish(card); }","note":"The generic disconnect path invokes the driver's finish hook again before freeing the card, so the already-freed Coolkey private state is finalized a second time.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"control","via":"disconnect cleanup"}]},
{"step":10,"file":"src/libopensc/card.c","function":"sc_disconnect_card","line":437,"var":"sc_card_free(card)","code":"sc_card_free(card);","note":"After the repeated finish call, the card object itself is freed, ending the lifecycle after the double-free condition has already been reached.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"control","via":"card teardown"}]}
]

print(p)
